instruction.name: xvinsgr2vr.d
instruction.description: Insert the low 64 bits of `b` into lane `imm` of `a`; the other lanes are unchanged.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvinsgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr1, $r5, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr2, $r6, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr3, $r7, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr4, $r8, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr5, $r9, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr6, $r10, 0; xvinsgr2vr.d $xr7, $r11, 0
